title: IAnalyticsStore.subscribeToSource fires for any path at or beneath the subscribed prefix and supports mid-path wildcards
content:
`subscribeToSource(source, callback)` is the change-notification half of `IAnalyticsStore`. It returns an unsubscribe function rather than taking a handle, so cleanup is a closure:

```typescript
const unsub = store.subscribeToSource(
  AnalyticsPath.fromString("atlas/"),
  (source) => { /* decide whether to requery */ },
);
// later
unsub();
```

Matching follows the same path semantics as the rest of the engine. Given a subscription to `atlas/`:

- `atlas/foo` fires it
- `atlas/foo/bar` fires it
- `rwa/foo` does not

Wildcards work at interior segments too. `atlas/*/test` fires for `atlas/foo/test`, `atlas/another-thing/test`, and `atlas/foo/test/a/b/c` — but not `rwa/foo/test`.

The mechanics in `AnalyticsSubscriptionManager` are worth knowing because they explain a surprise: notification walks the *prefixes of the updated path* and matches them against registered subscriptions. So an update to `/a/b/c` notifies subscribers of `/a/b/c`, `/a/b`, and `/a`. Wildcard patterns are then checked separately, segment by segment, and a wildcard subscription longer than the update path cannot match. Callbacks are wrapped in try/catch and every subscriber is delivered to even if an earlier one throws; the collected errors are re-raised together as a `NotificationError` after delivery completes.

The callback receives the updated `AnalyticsPath`, not the data. It is a hint to requery, which is exactly how `useAnalyticsQuery`'s `sources` option turns a static query into a live one.

Provenance: draft `03-Build/04-WorkWithData/_06-Analytics Engine/typescript/index.md`; behaviour verified in `packages/analytics-engine/core/src/AnalyticsSubscriptionManager.ts` and the interface in `packages/shared/analytics/types.ts` at 6.2.2-dev.45.
description: Subscribing to atlas/ fires for atlas/foo and atlas/foo/bar but not rwa/foo; atlas/*/test matches any middle segment. It returns an unsubscribe function.
